fields.meta_description: Build a TikTok landing page for an ad, your profile link, a video, or a creator program. See four examples with their numbers. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a TikTok Landing Page That Finishes What the Post Started
fields.hero_description: Build a TikTok landing page that repeats your video's hook, reads without zooming, and saves every signup to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds Behind the TikTok Link
fields.features_subheading: A TikTok landing page has one job: turn a tap in the app into an order or a signup, and keep the record.
fields.feature_1:
A page from one sentence

Describe the offer and where the link will sit, in an ad or on your profile. Emergent builds the page, its form, and the table behind it, and changes any field when you prompt again.
fields.feature_2:
The ad's tag on every signup

TikTok Ads Manager can add UTM parameters to the ad URL for you. The page reads them on load and saves utm_content beside each signup. Each row then names the ad behind it.
fields.feature_3:
A layout made for a phone

Ask for one column and large buttons, and Emergent builds it that way. Open it on your own phone before launch, and read every line, the form included, without pinching to zoom.
fields.feature_4:
Caps and cutoffs from the prompt

Tell Emergent to stop at 120 orders or to close at Friday noon, and the form follows that rule. Anyone who arrives after the cap sees a waitlist field where the form used to be.
fields.feature_5:
One rule, one person alerted

Set a rule such as 10,000 followers or more, and the app sends the entry to the person who handles it, by email or in Slack. Every entry that misses the rule waits in the table.
fields.feature_6:
Your domain, or your own code

Put the page on a custom domain, which uses credits, and keep editing it by prompt. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and run it on hosting you choose.

fields.usecase_heading: TikTok Landing Pages by Traffic Source
fields.tab_content_1:
Two ads, each opening on its own hook

Nightjar Cold Brew runs two In-Feed ads for one sample pack page. One opens on "No grinder needed", the other on "Night shift fuel", and the page headline repeats that line. Each signup is saved with the ad's utm_content. Of 640 signups, 410 came from No grinder needed and 230 from Night shift fuel.
fields.tab_content_2:
Pre-orders stop at loaf 120 for Saturday's bake

The link on Bramblecup Bakery's TikTok profile opens one page: Saturday sourdough pre-orders. It asks for a name, an email, the loaf, and a pickup time of 9am or noon. Once the 120th loaf is ordered, the form closes and a waitlist field takes its place. Every order is saved to the orders table.
fields.tab_content_3:
After the route video, 86 runners chose a pace

A route video goes up on Gristwell Run Club's account every Thursday, linked to an RSVP page for the Sunday 7am run. Runners give a name and pick a pace group. This week 86 signed up: 41 for the 10-minute mile group, 30 for the 9-minute group, and 15 for the 8-minute group. Each RSVP is saved with its pace group.
fields.tab_content_4:
Any creator at 10,000 followers or more reaches Pilar Wendt

Driftwell Skin recruits creators for its mineral sunscreen through one application page. It asks for a TikTok handle, a follower count, and a content niche. An application at 10,000 followers or more is emailed to Pilar Wendt, who leads partnerships. Smaller creators join the sample box list in the applications table.

fields.howto_title: How to Build a TikTok Landing Page
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to a TikTok landing page that matches its video, reads on a phone, and records where each signup came from.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Pick the one thing the page asks for
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Choose where the link will sit
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Show the offer before the form
fields.howto_step_1_des: Decide whether the page takes an order, a signup, an RSVP, or an application, and build it for that alone. Leave off the site menu and the links to other offers. One page with one form is easier to read on a phone and easier to measure.
fields.howto_step_2_des: An In-Feed ad, the website link on your profile, and a link you mention in a video reach different viewers. Give each its own page or its own tag. Check in the app that your account can show a profile link before you plan around it.
fields.howto_step_3_des: TikTok's ad policy says ad content needs to be consistent with the promoted product or service on the landing page. Put the ad's first line in the headline, and show the same product and price the video showed.
fields.howto_step_4_des: For ad traffic, TikTok does not allow landing pages that require viewers to enter personal information in order to access the main content. Put the offer and its details above the form, and ask only for fields you will use.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Turn on the UTM option in TikTok Ads Manager, or add the parameters by hand, and give each ad its own utm_content value, such as no-grinder-needed. Then ask Emergent to save that value on every signup row.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Test it on your own phone
fields.howto_step_6_des: TikTok's landing page checklist says all of your text, including buttons, should be easy to read without having to zoom in. Open the page upright and sideways, and submit one test entry before the ad goes live.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Compare ads by signups each week
fields.howto_step_7_des: Sort the table by utm_content once a week and compare ads by signups, not by views. Keep the ad that brings more signups. Write a new first line for the other, and give it a fresh utm_content value before it runs again.

faq_plan.q: What is a TikTok landing page?
faq_plan.a: A TikTok landing page is the web page a viewer opens from a TikTok ad, the website link on a profile, or a link mentioned in a video. Build it around one offer and one short form, laid out for a phone, and save each entry with the link that brought it.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a TikTok landing page?
faq_plan.a: Pick the one action the page asks for and the ad or profile link that will point to it. Then describe the page to Emergent's AI landing page builder: the offer and the form fields, plus any cap or rule. Paste the published URL into the ad or your profile, and send one test entry.

faq_plan.q: What should a TikTok landing page include?
faq_plan.a: A headline that repeats the video's first line, the offer and its price, one short form, and one button. Add a sentence on what happens after the submit, such as the pickup time or when you will reply. Leave off the site menu, which pushes the form further down a phone screen.

faq_plan.q: Do I need a separate TikTok landing page for ads and for my profile link?
faq_plan.a: Yes, or at least a separate tag on each link. An ad viewer saw one offer in one video. Open the page on that offer. Your profile link stays up for weeks and can point to whatever you sell now. For a push across email and ads at once, a campaign landing page keeps that offer in one place.

faq_plan.q: How do I see which video sent each signup to my TikTok landing page?
faq_plan.a: Give each ad link its own utm_content value; TikTok describes utm_content as the parameter for the creative. The profile link carries no ad tag. Add your own, such as utm_source=tiktok_profile, to the URL you paste. On a page built with Emergent, those values sit on each signup row in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Does a TikTok ad's landing page have to match the ad?
faq_plan.a: Yes. TikTok's ad policy gives a plain example of a mismatch: an ad that features product A, but the landing page shows product B. The same policy lists landing pages that are not mobile-friendly among the pages it does not allow. Check the layout on a phone as well as the offer.

faq_plan.q: How many fields should a TikTok landing page form have?
faq_plan.a: As few as the job needs: an email for a guide, or four fields for an order, as Bramblecup's pre-order page uses. Save questions about company size and job title for a linkedin landing page aimed at business buyers. Each field you drop is one less thing to type on a phone keyboard.

faq_plan.q: Can I change a TikTok landing page after the video is posted?
faq_plan.a: Yes. As long as the URL stays the same, the video and your profile keep sending people to it. Emergent changes the page by prompt: a sold-out notice or a new pickup time takes one sentence. Keep the headline matched to any ad that is still running.

faq_plan.q: Can I build a TikTok landing page without a website?
faq_plan.a: Yes. A single page at its own address can take orders or signups with no site behind it. Emergent's free tier covers building and publishing that page, with a live URL you can paste into your profile.

faq_plan.q: Can one TikTok landing page also take traffic from other social apps?
faq_plan.a: Yes, when every post makes the same offer. Tag each link, such as utm_source=tiktok on one and utm_source=instagram on the other. The table then shows which app sent each signup. When the posts promise different things, build an instagram landing page with its own headline.

plan.angle: No live top 10 was pulled for this Wave 3 keyword, so the page wins on what a searcher building one needs: the four places TikTok traffic actually lands (an In-Feed ad, the profile link, a link shared from a video, a creator program) and a page for each that opens on a phone, repeats the video's promise and saves every signup with where it came from. TikTok's own rules are sourced: the profile link needs 1,000 followers or a Registered Business Account, ad content must match the landing page, text must read without zooming, and Ads Manager can add UTM parameters for you.
